title: Mario's regression: a device pushed into his wrist

tellings.quote: And he bends my wrist backwards and he goes down into my wrist with it.

plain: An Air Force veteran named Mario Woods says that in 1977 he was taken aboard a craft, and that under regression, a hypnosis session meant to bring back buried memories, he recalled a being bending his wrist backwards and pushing a device into it. Woods tells this himself on the show, saying "he goes down into my wrist with it," which if true would mean something was implanted in him.
